notes.title: Traveler of Wuxia English Version Announce
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43341309/24ba83772298a00e8046def4d131b8446f2d9d64.png[/img]

Hello everyone:

We’re happy to announce that Traveler of Wuxia is finally getting its English version on Steam!
After a long translation and proofreading process, we are excitedly looking forward to bringing the English version to more players, inviting them to join Little Shrimp on an adventure in the world of Heluo. Together, let's experience the Eastern Wuxia fantasy world!

If you come across any translation errors or inaccuracies, please feel free to provide feedback and suggestions in the Steam Discussion forum at any time!

notes.title: Core gameplay changes and adjustments
notes.notes:
[h2]This adjustment needs to be re-opened for some mechanisms to work normally[/h2]

[h3]Adjustment of gameplay mechanism[/h3]
[list]
[*] When receiving card rewards, you can choose to replace existing cards of the same type, or directly add to the deck.
[*] When buying a card in the store, you can choose to replace the existing card of the same type, or directly add it to the deck.
[*]Seal option is no longer available when receiving card rewards.
[*]Skip card rewards, adjust silver cards from 25 coins to 20 coins, gold cards from 60 coins to 40 coins.
[/list]
[h3]Yunyou doctor event adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] The option [Pay 50 money, delete a card] is changed to [Pay 50 money, each team deletes 1 card].
[*]Changed gold increment from 25 to 50 per use of San Gong Soup.
[/list]
[h3]Hundred Soldiers Event Adjustment[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enhancement is now changed to the protagonist and teammate each strengthening 1 card, and the number of candidates for strengthening is 5 cards.
[/list]
